name: week
title: Gallery week
subtitle: Private working record. Demo data is fictional.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.sql: select * from attention order by kind,reference

sections.title: Consignments
sections.sql: select stock,title,artist,days_left,agreement_ref from consignment_due order by days_left

sections.title: Collectors
sections.sql: select collector,title,followup_on,days_overdue from collector_followups order by followup_on

sections.title: Sales ledger
sections.note: Amounts stay in their original currency. Artist shares use recorded contract percentages, before tax adjustments. This is not a tax ledger.
sections.sql: select ref,artist,title,currency,total_cents,collector_balance_cents,artist_balance_cents,settlement_status from settlements order by currency,artist

sections.title: Resale review
sections.note: Indicative amounts only. Copyright Agency determines eligibility. Nothing is submitted automatically.

sections.title: Inventory
sections.sql: select stock,title,artist,status,location,currency,price_cents,condition_date from inventory order by location,stock
